scope: Great Ape and boss-exclusive skill taxonomy corrections

corrections.name: Energy Cannon
corrections.effect: Creates turrets that fire a volley of small Ki Blasts followed by three larger Ki Blasts.
corrections.reason: Dedicated Xenoverse skill documentation explicitly categorizes Energy Cannon as Super and Ki Blast and identifies Final Form Demigra as its user.

notes: Keeps only records not already represented by the canonical catalog or earlier research batches. Final Flash (Super) was removed because canonical skills.json already contains it; Bloody Sauce was removed because Batch 285 now covers it. Energy Cannon remains a formal metadata correction against Batch 283. Added four previously absent character-signature skills: Ice Claw, Dragon Flash Bullet, Whirlwind Blade, and Gigantic Omega; dedicated pages establish their taxonomy and costs. Removed Dragon Flash Bullet and Whirlwind Blade from this batch because they are already established in Batch 265; duplicate non-correction identities would fail validate_research_batches.py. Removed duplicate Giant Storm identity; canonical research remains in Batch 285. Removed duplicate Gigantic Slam; retained the earlier canonical record in Batch 285. Added Great Ape-specific catalog records for Gigantic Ki Blast, Super Great Ape Beam, Boulder Toss, and Boulder Break. Boulder Toss/Boulder Break retain the conservative Other subtype because available sources establish them as Great Ape Super Skills/projectiles but do not expose a dedicated Xenoverse 2 Attack Type field.
